reading.title: Routes, loads and vessel roles
reading.text: Tide is the regular rise and fall of sea level. Wave is a moving surface disturbance, tanker carries bulk liquids, and submarine can travel below the water. Tide is distinct from a single passing wave. The container holds transported goods. Captain commands the vessel, sailor is a crew member, and cargo means the carried goods. The account distinguishes the freight container from its contents and from crew roles. Navigation means planning and following a route. A shipping lane is a recognized route used by vessels. The chart supports navigation along the specified lane; the language account does not prescribe an actual vessel route.
